descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Some robots are built to survive anything. This one just has to survive you.**

Welcome to MDMX Labs, where the world's most advanced (and suspiciously wobbly) humanoid - Unit EDISON - is yours to take apart, with 25+ weapons across a stack of arenas. We call it "Percussive Maintenance." Every dent is cash; cash funds bigger weapons; bigger weapons make bigger dents.


**FEEL EVERY IMPACT**

[media]
Active Ragdoll physics means Edison reacts to every hit, flailing to keep balance in hilarious ways. Feel the *crunch* as a well-thrown chair sends it stumbling.

**WITNESS REAL-TIME DESTRUCTION**

[media]
Dents, scratches, and oil leaks spread across the chassis as you fight. No two beatdowns ever look the same.

**GAME FEATURES**

- **CASH IN on Chaos:** every dent adds to the repair bill. Damage = profit, so chase the biggest score.
- **UNLOCK 25+ weapons & gadgets** across 9 R&D tiers, from a humble mop to gravity guns and one very illegal minigun.
- **CLIMB from Janitor to the Board of Directors**, unlocking surreal arenas from the lab to the Moon.

- **SURVIVE Endless Mode:** infinite robots, infinite chaos.

[media]

**EARLY ACCESS**

Jump in now and help shape the future of robot destruction. More bots, arenas, and wilder tools are coming, and your feedback steers the ship.

[media]

👉 **Join our Discord:** https://discord.gg/ScUYumVFKN

Let's create some chaos together!
